title: DOW-UAP-D75, Mission Report, Gulf of Aden, July 2024
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Mission Report (MISREP) from the U.S. Department of War regarding a UAP sighting in the Gulf of Aden on July 14, 2024, featuring significant redactions under 1.4(a) and 1.4(g).

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator observed one UAP maintaining a straight flight path at the same altitude, with speed faster than the aircraft's flying speed.
behavior: straight flight path at same altitude
followed the UAP till the distance became too far
incidents.quote: UAP's speed was faster than the flying speed
